reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the N-doping strategy, Pt-rich shell, and M–N bond mechanism from P2/P3/P5/P6 (which studied an electrocatalyst for ORR) to a different application (automotive exhaust catalysis) without providing a mechanistic justification for why it should work under the new conditions (transient low-temperature exhaust, H2O, NO, thermal aging). The core idea, intervention, and mechanism are taken almost verbatim from a single body of work, making it a straightforward application of an existing result to a new context with only minor contextual changes.
